name: Bill Shuster
summary:
William Franklin Shuster ( SHOO-stər; born January 10, 1961) is an American politician and lobbyist who served as the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 9th congressional district from 2001 to 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party, and is a son of former congressman Bud Shuster.
In January 2018, Shuster announced his retirement from Congress at the end of his eighth term, and did not run for re-election in 2018.
